summary: Interest under Employee’s Compensation Act, 1923: s.4A(3) mandates 12% p.a. on default; higher rate discretionary but capped at scheduled bank lending rates; penalty up to 50% allowable, 40% imposed; insurer liable when impleaded and fails to appeal; interest accrues from date of accident; award of 6% modified to 12%; appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Pradeep Narain Singh Deo vs. Srinivas Sabate
North East Karnataka Road Transport Corporation vs. Sujatha
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; award modified to 12% interest per annum from date of accident; 40% penalty upheld; insurer's liability confirmed.
